messages:
julia: Ran a preview apply for the new routing-weight config and noticed cohort drift between console and API preview. Console shows cohort A = 12% but backend logs indicate only ~8% of sampled requests. Anyone else?

nate: I saw similar discrepancy yesterday. Console uses a sticky hashing algorithm for cohorts; runtime uses an experimental consistent-hash that ignores the console's seed value.

preeti: Oof. That explains it. The preview cohort needs a single source of truth for hashing and the seed should be part of the preview metadata.

matt: Agreed. Concrete ask: preview metadata returned by POST /v1/configs/preview should include cohort_seed, cohort_algo, and sample_rate so runtime and console align.

julia: Also telemetry: we got some preview metrics mixed into main dashboards because they lacked preview label. We need an opt-in tag like redwood.preview=true and preview.co = <cohort_id>.

telemetry-bot: NOTE: recommended fields: preview=true, preview.cohort_id, preview.cohort_seed, preview.config_hash. Telemetry-team: please review.

nate: Another issue: when configs change quickly, cohort ids rotate and metrics fragment. Suggest including config_hash and preview_epoch in every emitted metric to allow grouping across small edits.

preeti: UX suggestion: console should display a timeline of preview edits and allow selecting a specific preview_epoch to view aggregated metrics for that epoch.

matt: Implementation plan: 1) API contract: preview response includes cohort_seed, cohort_algo, preview_epoch, sample_rate. 2) Runtime: read cohort_seed from preview header X-Preview-Seed and apply same hashing. 3) Telemetry: tag metrics with preview.* fields and mark preview=true so dashboards filter by default.

julia: Performance caveat: adding token probes for every preview request can be expensive. Let's do sampled token probes, but ensure sample_rate is included in telemetry and response.

nate: We should also add a small 'replay' endpoint to re-evaluate routing decisions on historical traces if teams want exact parity without live sampling. POST /v1/preview/replay {preview_id, trace_window}.

preeti: Legal flagged: confirm preview metrics are non-billable and can't be used for quota enforcement. Add header X-Redwood-Dryrun: true that propagates to billing and quota pipelines.

opsbot: ACTION: nate to open runtime PR to respect X-Preview-Seed; preeti to start telemetry-schema proposal; matt to update API docs; julia to prototype console timeline. ETA EOW.

julia: I'll mock the timeline panels and include a reliability badge (low/medium/high) based on sample_count and CI.

nate: I'll add a fallback: if X-Preview-Seed missing, runtime returns 412 with message referencing docs. Safer than divergent cohorts.

preeti: Telemetry-team: will draft schema with flat labels and example Grafana queries. Will also include guidance to filter preview=true by default.

matt: Thanks. If we gate preview telemetry emission behind an org opt-in for the pilot, we reduce risk.

telemetry-bot: REMINDER: when drafting schema, avoid nested fields; use flat tags like preview_cohort_id and preview_config_hash.

opsbot: REMINDER: update ops runbook for deleting leaked preview metrics and how to handle accidental promotion.

julia: Great. We'll capture follow-ups in PRs and schedule a 30-min sync mid-week.
